# macOS `mount` output

`15/mount.txt` follows the line format of `/sbin/mount` on macOS 15
(`<source> on <mount point> (<fs type>, <options>)`), with anonymized hosts and users.
It was written from that format, not captured: replace it with a real capture
(`mount > mount.txt` on a Mac with an SMB share mounted, hosts anonymized) when one is at hand.
